description: AIR Credit combines powerful machine learning credit intelligence with AI agents directly inside ChatGPT. Instantly assess companies, uncover emerging credit risks before they become obvious, understand the drivers behind every rating, and test future scenarios in seconds. Whether you're evaluating counterparties, investments, suppliers, or borrowers, AIR helps you make faster, more informed decisions without leaving the conversation.
